release_note: Wave 5 carrier architecture: source-pinned read-only semantic navigation is exposed through GET /gaiaos/context and MCP gaia_context using Gaia-native DictionaryOS term/alias resolution plus explicit YggdrasilOS graph traversal. The carrier boots through api/gaiaos_app.py as version 1.5.0. Repository CI run 85 passed the new carrier context canary, prior GaiaOS canaries, Python compilation, Docker/OpenAPI/source-surface verification. Deployment and external host adoption remain separately unproven. The current six operator slots remain placeholders until Naomi adopts or changes them; donor architecture does not transfer Raven identity, ownership, continuity, or voice.
